description: Use when you need to extract text from a pdf, pdf to text or document parsing for an LLM. Do not use for scanned PDFs (no OCR), password-protected files or files over 15 MB. Returns JSON with PDF text extraction: the text of each page (first 20 pages) plus title, author and producer metadata for 0.0025 USDC per page, up to 0.05 USDC per call (clients without upto pay the cap). Result in the same call (about 10000 ms); a status tool polls for free if it takes longer. Category: Data.

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the PDF file, e.g. https://example.com/report.pdf (up to 15 MB)

name: blackwood_pdf_extract

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one
